For example; Tc of the custom instruction in Figure 4(a) is 2 Note that we have assumed that the delay of each cluster is equivalent to two software clock executions. This is a reasonable   assumption as the FPGA logic can generally   execute at significantly higher clock frequency than a commercially available soft processor core cycle
